paite: TOUPA'N athaunilh, Kura, namte ama a phukpai ding leh, kumpipate kawnggakte phelsak ding a, ama a kongkhakte honsak ding leh, kulh kongkhakte khak louh a omsak dingpa, akhut taklam ka letpa kiang ah, hichi in achi:
heading: Toupa'n Kura Asep
english: Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

paite: "Kei na ma ah ka pai ding a, aphok lailai ka kibangsak ding; dal kongkhak ka hihse vek ding a, akalhna siktawnte ka tansak ding;
english: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.

paite: TOUPA, na min a hon sampa, Israel' Pathian ka hi chih na theihtheihna ding in mial lak a goute ka hon pe ding a, mundai a sum selte leng ka hon pe ding.
english: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

paite: Jakob ka sikhate leh Israel ka telte ziak in na min in ka hon sam a; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na min ka hon phuahsak hi.
english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.

paite: Keimah TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na tai ka hon gaksak ding hi.
english: I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

paite: Keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei chih nisuahna lam a kipan leh tumlam a kipan atheihtheihna ding un. kei TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei.
english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and there is no one else.

paite: Vak ka bawl a, mial leng ka bawl hi; kituahna ka bawl a, siatna leng ka bawl hi; kei zaw TOUPA, huchibang thilte hih zelpa ka hi," chi in.
english: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.

paite: Vante aw, tunglam a kipan takkhesak un, van dumte'n diktatna sungsuk uhen; hotdamna adotkhiak theihna ding un lei kihong henla, diktatna toh poukhawm hen; kei, TOUPA'N huaite ka siam ahi.
english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, Yahweh, have created it.

paite: Amah bawlpa kinakpihmi tung agik hi! Bellei in avel mi kiang ah, "Bang a hon bawl na hia?" achi dia hia? Ahihkeileh, nna na sep in, "Akhut in siam anei kei?" achi dia hia?
heading: Thilsiam Leh Khangthu TOUPA
english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?

paite: Apa kiang a, "Bang chi suang na hia?" chimi tung hiam, anu kiang a, "Bang toh ahia na hinkhiak ding?" chimi tung agik hi!
english: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, amau Bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Thil hong tung ding thu hon dong unla; ka tapate leh ka khut nasepte ah thu hon pia un.
english: Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!

paite: Leitung ka bawl a, atung a mihing omte leng ka siam hi; keimah in ka khut ngei in, van ka kaipalh a, asepaihte thu ka pia hi.
english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

paite: Kura diktatna nei in ka dingsak a, alampite teng ka tangsak ding; ama'n ka khopi abawl nawn ding a, atatna man uh deih ziak in hilou in, kipahman deih ziak leng hilou in, ka salte apawtsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Aigupta semgimte leh Ethiopia sumsinmi leh Saviate misang pipite na kiang uah ahong pai ding ua, nou a ding in a-om ding ua; nou ahon zui ding ua; khainiang bun in ahi ahong pai ding uh; huchi in bokkhup in, Pathian noumau ah a-om hi; adang himhim a-om kei, pathian dang himhim a-om kei, chi in ahong thum ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

paite: Israel' Pathian aw, Hondampa, Pathian kisel nakpa na hi ngut hi.
english: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”

paite: Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, ahi, avek un zumtak in a-om ding uh; milim bawl mite zumna ah alut ding uh.
english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

paite: Israelte bel tangtawn hotdamna a TOUPA hotdam in a-om ding uh; tangtawn in na zahlak kei ding ua, na zumsak kei ding uhi.
english: Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

paite: TOUPA van siampa'n, amah Pathian, lei bawl a siampa ahi; ama'n lei akipsak a, bangmah lou ding in abawl kei a, mihing omna ding in abawl a, hichi in achi ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi; adang a-om kei.
english: For Yahweh who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am Yahweh. There is no other.

paite: Aguk in, mun mial ah, thu ka gen ngei kei a; Jakob suante kiang ah bangmah lou ding in hon zong un, ka chi ngei kei; kei TOUPA'N diktatna thu ka gen zel a, thudik mahmahte ka gen zel hi.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, Yahweh, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

paite: Kikhawm unla hong pai un; namte lak a gawtna pelte aw, hong pai nai chiat un; asing milim bawltawm tawi a, mi hondam theiloupi pathian kiang a thum zelte'n theihna himhim anei kei uh.
heading: Leitung TOUPA Leh Babulon Milimte
english: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.

paite: Gen unla, hon pawtkhesak un; ahi, kidong uhenla; nidanglai a kipan kua'n ahia theisak? Huai hun lai a kipan kua'n ahia gen? Kei TOUPA'N ka hih ahi kei maw? Keimah lou ngal Pathian dang a-om kei; Pathian diktat leh hondampa ka hi; keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
english: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, Yahweh? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.

paite: "Kawlmong a mi tengteng aw, kei lam hong nga unla, hotdam in om un; kei lah Pathian ka hi ngal a, adang himhim a-om kei.
english: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

paite: Khuk chih ka ma ah akhukdin ding ua, lei chih in leng ka kiang ah kichiam in thu achiam ding chi in kei-le- kei kilou in ka kichiamta, thu lah diktatna in ka kam a kipan in apawtta a, ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
english: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.

paite: "Mi'n, TOUPA kia ah diktatna leh hatna a-om, chi in ka tanchin agen ding ua; amah kiang ah mi ahong pai ding ua, atung a lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak in a-omta ding uh.
english: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.

paite: Israel suan tengteng TOUPA ah ahi, siamtansak a a-om ua, TOUPA asuan ding uh," chi in.
english: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
